scenarios.title: Fix the broken web server
scenarios.summary: nginx is down and the default site is gone. Bring the website back.
scenarios.briefing: Visitors get nothing from this server. Find out why and bring the site back.
scenarios.solution:
```bash
sudo systemctl enable --now nginx
sudo ln -s /etc/nginx/sites-available/default /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default
sudo systemctl reload nginx
```

tasks.title: Start the web server
tasks.body: Get the web server running so people can use the website again.
tasks.solve:
fail() { echo "FAIL: $*"; exit 1; }
systemctl enable --now nginx

hints.body: `systemctl status nginx` shows whether nginx is active and why it failed.

tasks.title: Restore the default site
Make the site reachable
tasks.check:
fail() { echo "FAIL: $*"; exit 1; }
bash -euo pipefail -c 'fail() { echo "FAIL: $*"; exit 1; }
u='\''http://127.0.0.1/'\''; want=200
b=$(mktemp)
code=$(curl -sS --max-time 2 -o "$b" -w '\''%{http_code}'\'' --url "$u" 2>/dev/null) || fail "$u is not reachable."
[ "$code" = "$want" ] || fail "$u answered $code."
c='\''Welcome to nginx'\''
grep -Fq -- "$c" "$b" || fail "$u answered without the expected text."
' || fail 'Not done yet.'
